name: primitives-effects-image-zoom

frames.best_why: The zoomed view is sharp on the snowy peaks, showing the close-up detail the effect produces.

tagline: Mountain photo magnifies under the pointer and pans as you move.
summary: A rounded photo that slides to a close-up centred on the cursor when you hover, follows the pointer to pan, and toggles the zoom on click.
appearance: A rounded landscape photograph of snow-tipped peaks above a flat sea of clouds at dusk, filling a rounded card on a black stage. A small caption sits just below it.
behaviour: Hovering zooms the photo toward the pointer, and moving the mouse pans the enlarged view to the spot under the cursor; clicking toggles the zoom and leaving returns it to fit.
demo_content: A sunset photo of snowy peaks above a sea of clouds, captioned Hover to zoom, move to pan, click to toggle.
search_phrases: image that zooms where you hover
product photo close up on hover
click to toggle zoom on an image
use_when: A product or gallery photo should be inspectable up close without opening a lightbox.
avoid_when: It needs a pointer that can hover; on touch the zoom is a tap and panning fights the page scroll.
customise: Pass the image as children, and set zoom scale, transition, width, height and whether hover or click zoom; the pointer-to-origin maths is fixed.
weight_why: One image scaled by a transform; no loop or canvas.

a11y.note: Zoom is hover and click only on a non-focusable div, so keyboard users cannot zoom; the wrapper's img role has no name.

issues: Zoomed frames look slightly soft, since the 2.5x scale stretches the photo.
Nothing signals the hover zoom except the cursor changing shape.
polish_why: Smooth pointer-anchored zoom on a strong photo; no affordance and no reduced-motion handling.
title: Image Zoom
